title: Context.dev web data
description: Search the web and news, read pages, answer questions, and retrieve brand data with Context.dev.

environment.name: CONTEXT_DEV_API_KEY
environment.description: Context.dev API key with data:execute access. Keep this server-side.

environment.name: CONTEXT_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Random token (at least 32 characters) callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token>; required because Neon Function URLs are public.

operations.title: Search the web
operations.description: POST a query and optional numResults (1-10) to find current source URLs.

operations.title: Read a web page
operations.description: POST an HTTP(S) URL to return up to 50,000 characters of Markdown and source metadata.

operations.title: Answer a web question
operations.description: POST a task for a sourced answer; fast mode by default, ultra mode optional.

operations.title: Retrieve a brand
operations.description: POST a domain to get company identity, logo, colors, and social links.

operations.title: Search news
operations.description: POST a query or company domain to find articles, with an optional cursor for the next page.
